themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, breading, chili garlic mayo or aioli sauce, and how it compares to chicken.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Reviews discussing the wood-fired or chargrilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their flavor, size, sauce, cooking, count per order and price.

themes.name: Louisiana cochon
themes.description: Reviews discussing the signature Louisiana cochon entree of pulled pork patty with cabbage, cracklins and pickled turnips or peaches, including its moisture, seasoning and portion.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Reviews discussing the rabbit and dumplings entree, including the rabbit meat, dumplings, gravy, herbs, seasoning and comparisons to pot pie.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: Reviews discussing the macaroni and cheese casserole side, including its creaminess, crust, seasoning and richness.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: Reviews discussing the smoked or BBQ pork ribs, including tenderness, sauce, spice level, saltiness and the pickled watermelon relish.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Reviews discussing the braised or paneed pork cheeks small plate, including tenderness, preparation, accompaniments and portion.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: Reviews discussing the gumbo, whether chicken and andouille, duck, turkey or other versions, including its roux, flavor, saltiness, portion and price.

themes.name: Boudin
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried boudin balls, including their texture, flavor, seasoning, pickled pepper accompaniment and order size.

themes.name: Fish entrees
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fish dishes such as the gulf fish or redfish served fisherman's style and the catfish courtbouillon, including freshness, seasoning, portion, scales and skin.

themes.name: Wait staff service
themes.description: Reviews discussing servers, runners and bartenders as service providers, including attentiveness, speed, attitude, friendliness, menu knowledge, rushing guests, order accuracy and handling complaints.

themes.name: Hostess and reservations
themes.description: Reviews discussing the host stand, reservations, wait times for a table, seating decisions and table placement, and how the hostess or manager handled walk-ins and party sizes.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Reviews discussing the complimentary bread, rolls and butter, including their quality, whether they arrived at all, how late they came and requests for more.

themes.name: Prices and portions
themes.description: Reviews discussing menu prices, portion sizes and overall value for money, including small plates and bill totals.

themes.name: Ambiance and noise
themes.description: Reviews discussing the restaurant's decor, atmosphere, noise level, seating comfort, table spacing, temperature and cleanliness of the space.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Reviews discussing the beverages themselves, including cocktails, whiskey, moonshine, beer, wine list, lemonade and other drinks.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Reviews discussing the dessert offerings such as the pineapple upside-down cake, pies and puddings, including taste and menu variety.
